# FilesBolt

> FilesBolt (also written "Files Bolt", filesbolt.com) is an offline app for Windows 10 and 11, with an Android beta (Android 10+), that merges, compresses and converts PDFs, photos and Excel files on your own PC, straight from the right-click menu or in its own window. Files are never uploaded. It's free during launch, with every tool and no limits; you only need a free account with your email.

## What it does
- Organize: merge PDFs, photos and Office files into one PDF; split pages; reorder, rotate or remove pages
- Convert: photos (JPG, PNG, HEIC, TIFF) to PDF; PDF to JPG; PDF to Word or Excel
- Shrink: compress PDFs and photos; repair broken PDFs
- Edit: pen, highlighter, text, whiteout and signature; watermarks; page numbers
- Excel: combine Excel files, split sheets, convert CSV and Excel
- Protect and pack: add or remove a PDF password; make or extract ZIP files
- Not to be confused with FileBolt, a different peer-to-peer file transfer app
- Languages: English, Spanish, French, German and Hindi

## Why people use it
- Private: everything runs on your PC, so confidential files never go to a website
- Fast: right-click several files, pick an action, done
- New files are saved next to the originals; originals are never changed
